title: Malaysia Digital Marketing Strategies: Effective in 2027

facts.fact: Shahida D'Herbs sold RM100,000 of product in two hours on Shopee Live during Shopee's 9.9 sale, per the author's account.
facts.quote: Shahida D'Herbs sold RM100,000 of product in two hours on Shopee Live

facts.fact: Shopee says Live and Video together drew 1.7 billion views across the 9.9 sale, about a third more than a year earlier (vendor's own figure).
facts.quote: Shopee says Live and Video together drew 1.7 billion views across the sale, about a third more than a year earlier.

facts.fact: The author states that roughly seven in ten influencer campaigns in Malaysia are awareness plays, versus about four in ten performance-led across the APAC region (author's own estimate).
facts.quote: Roughly seven in ten influencer campaigns here are still awareness plays, against about four in ten performance-led across the region.

facts.fact: The author runs campaigns across ten APAC markets.
facts.quote: I run campaigns across ten APAC markets

facts.fact: Shopee carries more than half of MONTIGO's online sales, and that share grew by more than 60 percent in the first part of 2026 (case claim in the article).
facts.quote: Shopee now carries more than half of MONTIGO's online sales, and that share grew by more than 60 percent in the first part of 2026.

facts.fact: TikTok Shop says live sessions bring in almost a third of everything sold on the platform in Malaysia (platform's own claim).

facts.quote: Malaysian sellers' sales during Ramadan and Raya ran about half above a regular day.
